description.en-US: Idle Fantasy is a free and open source offline idle RPG inspired by classic MMORPGs. Train skills, fight in dungeons, craft gear, and complete quests. No internet connection, account, or ads required. Features • 23 trainable skills: Mining, Fishing, Woodcutting, Farming, Thieving, Smithing, Cooking, Fletching, Crafting, Firemaking, Runecrafting, Herblore, Construction, Prayer, Mercantile, Agility, Slayer, Attack, Strength, Defense, Ranged, Magic, and Hitpoints • Session-based training: Start a session and close the app. Come back up to an hour later to collect your loot and XP. Agility reduces session time. • 29 dungeons: Fight solo bosses and enemies to earn combat XP, coins, and rare drops. Equip weapons and armour to deal more damage. • Crafting system: Smelt bars, cook fish, fletch bows and arrows, craft jewellery. Consume gathered materials and earn XP and items. • Prayer: Bury bones collected from combat to earn Prayer XP. • Equipment system: Equip weapons, armour, tools, and jewellery to boost stats and skill efficiency. • Quest system: 189 quests spanning all skills. Earn XP rewards on completion. • Pet system: Rare pets can drop while training skills. Each pet provides a permanent XP boost to their linked skill. • Achievements: Track milestones across levelling, combat, quests, and collections. • NPC Shop: Buy supplies and sell your gathered resources for coins. • No ads. No accounts. No internet required. Your save data stays on your device. • Translations: Partial and full translations available for 18 languages. Idle Fantasy is free software released under the GPL-3.0 licence. Source code is available on the project repository. Get updates faster Add the official Idle Fantasy repository to F-Droid to receive updates as soon as they are released, instead of waiting for the main F-Droid index to catch up. 1. Open F-Droid and go to Settings → Repositories 2. Tap + and paste: https://idlefantasy.tristinbaker.xyz/fdroid/repo 3. Search for Idle Fantasy, open the app page, and under Repositories set Idle Fantasy as the preferred source.

whatsNew.en-US:
• Added heirloom items: unique rare drops from the three raid bosses, one for every gathering and artisan tool plus attack, strength, ranged, and magic weapons
• Heirlooms start at iron quality and permanently level up to 99 as you earn XP with them equipped, reaching stats 50% beyond the current best gear at max level
• Prestiging a skill temporarily weakens its heirloom; full power returns at level 85, and the heirloom's own level is never lost
• Heirlooms cannot be sold, and a raid boss never

• Fixed the Skills tab quest counter counting bury-any-bones guild quests once per bone type, making 4 remaining quests show as 20
• Fixed the Golden Goose pet showing +10% XP in the pet collection; it now correctly shows +10% Coins
• Made 166 item names translatable that were previously locked to English (thanks MarcMush!)
• Many more texts now follow your language: session collect dialog titles, loot and reward names, queue and notification labels, quest chips in skill sheets, bestiary headers
